subject: Order Form redlines — confidentiality carveouts & press approval SLA
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@orchard.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Li <aaron.li@orchard.ai>
Date: 2027-06-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MSA / Order Form questions on press & logo usage

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orchard's product team is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. The procurement team asked us to surface a few items in the MSA and the draft order form that are blocking internal sign-off:

1) Confidentiality carveouts — they want a narrow list of permitted disclosures for press and analyst briefings.
2) Press approval window — request for a 7-business-day review period before Orchard can be quoted or named in press.
3) Logo custody and usage — marketing needs a clear approval flow and a master logo file in vector format.

Can you confirm Redwood's standard position and whether the Order Form can include a short addendum to tighten the confidentiality carveouts and set a firm review SLA?

Attaching the draft Order Form with inline comments (see attached). Happy to set up a quick call with procurement and legal if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Partnerships, Orchard AI
T: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: OrderForm_v3.docx (annotated)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@orchard.ai>; Aaron Li <aaron.li@orchard.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-24T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA / Order Form questions on press & logo usage

Hi Elena — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Karthik (revops) to give a short answer and next steps.

High-level:
- Confidentiality carveouts: Redwood typically permits disclosures to auditors and regulators and allows press quotes with prior written approval. We can discuss narrowing the carveout to expressly exclude naming for product marketing unless explicit sign-off occurs.
- Press approval SLA: We don't often promise under 10 business days for legal redline approval, but for logo+quote we can commit to a 7-business-day review SLA on the Order Form as an exception — subject to final language and executive sign-off.
- Logo custody: We can provide master SVG/AI files once a signed order is executed and a completed brand request form is returned.

Kimberly — can you weigh in on suggested redline language for a 7-business-day approval window and a tighter carveout clause? Karthik and I will prepare a short addendum if legal signs off.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Elena Torres <elena.torres@orchard.ai>
Date: 2027-06-25T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA / Order Form questions on press & logo usage

Team / Elena —

Quick draft suggestions to resolve Orchard's asks while protecting Redwood: please consider the below as redline-friendly language. I can produce a clean addendum if you confirm.

1) Confidentiality carveouts (proposed): 
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Customer may disclose Confidential Information only (a) to the extent required by law or regulation; (b) to Customer's auditors or legal advisors under written confidentiality obligations; and (c) in public press or analyst communications only with Provider's prior written approval, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld. Provider may require redaction of technical details that would materially facilitate replication of Provider's services."

2) Press approval SLA (proposed addendum clause): 
"Provider will review and approve or provide written objections to Customer-proposed quotes, press releases, or use of Provider's name/logo within seven (7) business days following receipt of a complete submission. If Provider fails to respond within seven (7) business days, approval will be deemed granted. Customer will provide a final draft and all materials necessary for Provider's review."

3) Logo custody / use: include a brand request form in the Order Form as Exhibit A, and require Customer to submit desired assets. Provider will supply source logo files after receipt of a completed form and a signed Order Form.

Open points: fallback if either party is in a blackout due to compliance (we can add a carveout), and whether to offer a one-time exception to the deemed-approval rule for joint announcements at conferences.

If Elena is okay with the SLA and carveout language, Grace/ Karthik please confirm and I will generate a redline PDF to send back.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Aaron Li <aaron.li@orchard.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@orchard.ai>
Date: 2027-06-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA / Order Form questions on press & logo usage

Thanks Kimberly — this is helpful and much closer to what Procurement wants. Two quick clarifications from Orchard:

- On deemed approval: can you confirm that the 7-business-day clock starts when Orchard submits a "complete submission"? We'd like a short checklist (i.e., final draft, logo spec, screenshot of usage context) to avoid disputes on completeness.
- On redaction: Procurement wants technical detail redaction to be limited — can you provide one example of the type of detail Redwood would redact versus accept?

We're attaching our internal suggested edits to the MSA and a logo usage sample. Can we agree to a short 30-minute alignment call tomorrow (Tue) at 10am PT to finalize the addendum?

Attachments: Orchard_annotated_MSA_redlines.pdf, Logo_usage_guidelines_v2.pdf

Aaron Li
Senior Procurement Manager, Orchard AI

Subject: Re: Initial MSA / Order Form questions on press & logo usage

Aaron / Elena — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming next steps and owners: 

1) Kimberly will produce a redline addendum PDF including the 7-business-day SLA and the suggested confidentiality carveout language.
2) We'll add a short "completeness checklist" to Exhibit A that spells out what counts as a complete submission (final draft, usage screenshot, logo size/spec, contact person). That checklist will prevent clock disputes.
3) On redaction examples: Kimberly suggests we would redact detailed model configuration snippets (e.g., internal hyperparameters, model weights, or API keys) — non-sensitive summaries and high-level performance figures are fine. We will add a one-sentence example to the addendum.
4) Karthik will prepare the Order Form with the brand request Exhibit and route for approval internally.
5) Grace will schedule the 30-minute alignment call for Tue 2027-06-29 10:00 AM PT and circulate a short agenda.

DocuSign and final Order Form draft will follow after the redline is agreed. For transparency, attaching the Drive link with the current docs.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this.

Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
